{{Quote|My apologies citizens! Patrons are not allowed mechanical assistance at the games! Your droids must remain outside!|The Kilmaulsi guard speaks with Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa|<ref name="GW" />}}
A '''member''' of the<ref name="GW" /> [[Kilmaulsi]]<ref name="GATORW" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] worked as a [[Security guard/Legends|guard]] for the [[Casino Royale]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], when Rebel agents [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] came to Vorzyd in an attempt to shut down the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] income from the planet's [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], they were informed by the guard that their [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companions, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], wouldn't be able to accompany them into the Casino Royale, as no mechanical aid was allowed for [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]].<ref name="GW" /> The guard had [[Color/Legends|green]] and orange skin, black feathers and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="CSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The guard first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic strip]] ''[[Gambler's World]]'', which was written and illustrated by [[Russ Manning]] and distributed between between [[March]] [[March 12|12]] and [[September]] [[September 8|8]] in [[1979]] by the [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]] in American and Canadian newspapers.<ref name="GW" /> On [[August 9]], [[1994]],<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53780/classic_star_wars_the_early_adventures_1994_1|text=Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures (1994) #1}}</ref> the strip was reprinted in the comic book [[Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures 1|''Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures'' 1]] in color, revealing the skin and eye color of the character.<ref name="CSW" />
